name: Amagami Uzuki
source:
The younger sister of Amagami Kanna. Second heroine of Oni Kagura, Uzuki is logistic support representative and a shy art teacher with pigtails.
She is outwardly shy, delicate, and timid. A quiet girl with a gentle heart & low voice even when speak. Smart and loves animals.
Uzuki is small in stature and always hiding behind her sister, Kanna.
Unlike her sister, Uzuki doesn’t seem to hate Kijima.
